_comment: Quality floors for fbtberger-raft. Both numbers may only go UP -- see the kwatro repository's QUALITY.md. Pitest is pointed at the arithmetic the protocol rests on (Quorum, RaftConfig, storage), not at RaftNode: one mutant there means booting a cluster.
_coverage_note: The floor is 0.84 against 84.8-85.3 % measured over three runs (356 tests, no failures). It got here in three steps on 2026-08-30. The report stopped counting protoc output, which was two thirds of the lines and had nothing to do with the tests. The tests stopped sleeping: fixed waits became conditions, and where the code has an event to signal, latches on the RPC seam. And the three classes that were dark got tests -- RaftServer 0 to 53 %, RaftNodeConfiguration 38 to 79 %, RaftClient 39 to 70 %. The margin is for one thing, established rather than assumed: GrpcTransportServer's requestVote and appendEntries, ten lines, are recorded by JaCoCo in some runs and not in others with identical test outcomes. GrpcClusterTrafficTest asserts through a latch that both handlers were reached and is green in every run, including the runs where those lines read as uncovered. The code is exercised deterministically; the measurement is not. It happens with only those two tests selected, so it is not interference from the rest of the suite. Cause not established.
